tasks.short: Check building safety and secure doors after operating hours

steps.what: Read the current closing instructions and authorised exceptions
Walk the premises and inspect appliances, occupants and immediate hazards
Lock the required doors and address appliance hazards within authority
Physically verify that doors are secure and the closing route is safe

tasks.design: Keep the existing closing instructions directly available in {DOCS}. Retain the physical round, locking and verification; a document configuration cannot observe an unconnected appliance or verify a physical latch.
tasks.previous_blocker: The important inputs are actual occupants, appliances and door conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access supports the round, but no new capability in the supplied evidence replaces these checks.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising an unsafe exception without compromising access or fire safety.
tasks.human_edge: The janitor notices unfamiliar conditions and takes immediate safe action.
tasks.altitude: No change to responsibility or the working week from this design.

reach.learn: Local emergency access and escalation procedures

evidence.claim: A digital checklist alone does not verify physical doors or appliance hazards; this is model knowledge.

assumptions: The focal role is the janitor on a routine closing round. All shares are E1 estimates, not measurements. Existing instructions are already directly available; s1 separates the real lookup from physical work and earns no invented navigation saving.

The facilities supervisor supplies current location, closing times, authorised occupied areas and safety instructions. The janitor reads these in s1 and observes actual conditions in s2. No live sensor inventory, door-state feed or automatic hazard classifier is assumed. Missing instructions require human clarification, with no saving claimed.

This routine round does not establish a separate completion log, photo record or message that anyone keeps today. An actual repair notification is explicitly addressed in task 9544. No automatic locking or consequential software command is introduced; physical actions remain with the janitor.

No new configuration or record is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero. Existing document maintenance remains unchanged facilities work. A native checklist was considered but would not remove any named action in this already-direct-access case.
unknowns: Is a separate closing log actually required and read?
Are any door or appliance checks already automated, and which physical checks remain necessary?
research_questions: Does an observed round contain an actual repeated record write or second-system entry absent from this routine case?

incremental.description: No new tool, mapping or ongoing upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All 100 focal hours remain. Instructions already have direct access; the actual inspection, locking and final physical verification remain. A checklist without connected and verified building controls removes none of those actions.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Notify managers about major repairs or additions to building systems

steps.what: Inspect the observed fault or inadequate building service without performing unsafe diagnostics
Capture actual location, symptoms and immediate risks in the existing repair request
Determine what requires management attention and identify the responsible manager
Prepare the actual notification describing the repair need and operational impact
Check the final notification meaning, location, urgency and intended manager
Send the checked repair notification to the responsible manager's internal queue
Clarify the observed problem with the manager and answer practical questions

tasks.design: Configure the actual {HELPDESK} repair form to reuse captured location and contact fields in the manager notification. After the janitor checks its final meaning and destination, route that exact notification to the manager's queue; keep observation, substantive writing and clarification human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fault observations and routing details are often entered again when notifying the manager.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form defaults and an approval-triggered internal route can reuse the existing request.
tasks.still_hard: Describing an uncertain fault without inventing its cause or authorising a major repair.
tasks.human_edge: The janitor distinguishes what was actually seen from what needs a specialist's diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated notification entry; management still decides about major repairs and additions.

reach.task: Triage a factual building repair request
reach.learn: Asset identification, urgency criteria and diagnostic limits

evidence.claim: Native request fields and approval-triggered internal routing can reduce repeat entry and a real manager notification send; this is model knowledge.

assumptions: This case already uses an actual repair request and a separate manager notification in {HELPDESK}. It is not an invented report added to a purely spoken warning. The focal role is the janitor; manager response time is outside these 100 focal hours.

The janitor produces location, asset label when present, observed symptoms, observed time and immediate risk in s1-s2. The facilities owner maintains manager routing and escalation instructions, which the janitor verifies in s3. Missing asset or manager mappings stop routing and are repaired manually within s3-s5; no clean fault feed is supplied free.

Of twenty notification hours, four are repeated location, reporter and request-reference entry removed by native defaults; sixteen retain substantive wording and correction. The real manager-queue send removes two hours; it is not an ordinary same-system save. Any ordinary draft save is included and unchanged in s2/s4.

s5 verifies the final content's meaning and exact manager queue after the draft exists. Edits invalidate the release approval. No supplier work order, purchase approval or repair commitment is issued. Shares and cuts are provisional E1 estimates; use native configuration before custom code.
unknowns: Is there a separate actual manager notification today?
Are location and reporter fields already reused?
Which managers receive which building-system requests?
research_questions: Can the native route bind the final request content and exact manager queue without hiding new fault capture?

already_counted.description: Fault capture, routing choice, final meaning checks and manual mapping repair

incremental.description: Maintain notification field defaults and manager routing after changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact final notification text, location, urgency and internal manager queue checked in s5; any change voids release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes four repeated-entry hours and two actual send hours, less one upkeep hour: net five. Cautious case: a novel addition needs all twenty notification-writing hours because the normal fields do not fit; the checked internal queue send still removes two hours, less one upkeep leaves one. Observation and conversation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Requisition cleaning and maintenance supplies or equipment

steps.what: Inspect remaining supplies and the condition of cleaning equipment
Capture actual counts and equipment needs in the existing requisition worksheet
Select suitable items and quantities against cleaning requirements and authorised products
Prepare the actual requisition with selected items, quantities and delivery details
Check the final requested items, units, quantities, justification and internal purchasing destination
Submit the checked requisition to the internal purchasing approval queue

tasks.design: Configure saved requester and delivery defaults in {PROCUREMENT}, using only the janitor's actual selected requisition lines. Retain physical stock checks, capture, suitability decisions and the final release to purchasing; this is an internal request rather than a supplier order.
tasks.previous_blocker: Request preparation repeats stable requester and delivery details alongside case-specific supply choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native requisition defaults can fill those stable fields without calculating unobserved stock or choosing chemicals.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting safe, suitable products and recognising when equipment needs replacement rather than more supplies.
tasks.human_edge: The janitor knows the actual cleaning conditions and can spot damaged or incompatible equipment.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less requisition administration; purchasing and budget authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review a cleaning-supply need against authorised products
reach.learn: Units of issue, chemical compatibility and purchasing rules

evidence.claim: Saved requester and delivery defaults can reduce repeated requisition fields without replacing physical stock checks or product selection. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The focal role is the janitor preparing an existing internal requisition. Actual count capture is explicitly retained in s2; no new stock data feed or free digital inventory is assumed. Purchasing approval and supplier ordering occur after this request and are not credited as janitor savings.

The janitor produces actual item needs and quantities in s1-s3. Purchasing supplies current catalogue item identifier, description, unit and authorised product status. The existing requester profile supplies site, cost centre and delivery location. Missing or conflicting defaults are corrected manually within the retained s4-s5 time.

Five of twenty-five preparation hours are repeat requester, site, cost-centre and delivery fields removed by native defaults. Twenty retain item and quantity entry, justification, checking available units and correction. Ordinary same-system saving is included at unchanged effort; the separate one-hour submission is a real consequential queue release and remains fully retained.

s5 approves the exact final requisition content and internal destination after preparation. This author check gates submission to another decision-maker, not saving the author's own draft. Any edit invalidates release. Shares and the removed field-entry work are provisional E1 estimates, sized from this requisition rather than the means prior.
unknowns: Are requester and delivery defaults already active?
How much actual requisition time is stable field entry?
Does the janitor use a worksheet or capture directly in the purchasing form?
research_questions: Do native requester defaults remove repeat entry while leaving actual stock capture and safe item selection visible?

already_counted.description: Retained requisition preparation, default repair and final substantive checks

incremental.description: Check requester and delivery defaults after site or purchasing changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact final item lines, units, quantities, justification, delivery location and purchasing queue checked in s5; edits invalidate release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes five stable-field hours less 0.5 upkeep: 4.5 net. Cautious case: replacement equipment needs a new delivery arrangement and cost allocation, or the standard fields already default; keep the present manual or configured route without adding another configuration and its upkeep. Physical counting and selection remain in every case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep safety rounds and supply judgement human while reducing genuine repeated repair-notification and requisition fields.
reach: Present factual building defects to facilities staff
Check cleaning-supply requests against authorised products
role.ambitious_version: A janitor with less repeated request entry and full attention retained for actual building conditions.

job.title: Janitors and Cleaners, Except Maids and Housekeeping Cleaners
